title: St. Nicholas Cathedral, Da Lat
geometryBasis: The named map polygon controls the plan and tower projection. The national and municipal accounts establish the 47 metre tower. The mapped envelope is smaller than the overall published site dimensions.
sectionBasis: Cleared photos show the cream pilasters and archivolts, grey spire with rooster and round dormers, ochre wall panels and red aisle roofs, plus the tall double rows of arched windows.
limitations: Current cathedral building exterior. Separate support buildings and interiors lie outside scope.
The mapped outline controls the individual exterior footprint; heights other than the belfry and concealed details are estimates.
